bridge-type.label: Mova/Dreame Account
bridge-type.description: Cloud account connection to the DreameHome/Mova cloud. After login, the device ID (did) is written to the openHAB log.

parameter.name: username
parameter.label: Username
parameter.description: E-mail address of your Mova/Dreamehome account.

parameter.name: accountType
parameter.label: Account Type
parameter.description: Brand of the app the account was created with (Mova app = mova, Dreamehome app = dreame).

parameter.name: country
parameter.label: Region
parameter.description: Cloud region of the account. Mova: eu, cn, us, sg, kr. Dreame: eu, cn, us, ru, sg, kr, by. Trouver: eu, us, ru, sg. If the login fails or the device list stays empty, try another region.

parameter.name: pollingInterval
parameter.label: Polling Interval
parameter.description: How often (in seconds) the state of the vacuum is polled.

thing-type.label: Mova/Dreame Robot Vacuum
thing-type.description: A single Mova/Dreame robot vacuum (e.g. Mova V50 Ultra), connected via the account bridge.

parameter.name: did
parameter.label: Device ID (did)
parameter.description: The device ID (did) of the vacuum. It is written to the openHAB log as soon as the account bridge is online (line "Mova/Dreame device found").

parameter.name: settingsInterval
parameter.label: Settings Polling Interval
parameter.description: How often (in seconds, at least 10) the settings are polled so that changes made in the app show up in openHAB quickly.

parameter.name: mapKey
parameter.label: Map Key (IV)
parameter.description: Optional: 16 character initialization vector for map decryption. Leave empty if the model is known.

parameter.name: mapRotation
parameter.label: Rotate Map
parameter.description: Clockwise rotation of the map image: -1 = automatic (value stored in the map), otherwise 0, 90, 180 or 270 degrees.

parameter.name: mapFlip
parameter.label: Flip Map
parameter.description: Flips the map image vertically (before rotating). Default: on, so the map looks like in the app.

parameter.name: showHiddenRooms
parameter.label: Show Hidden Rooms
parameter.description: Off (default): rooms hidden in the app are not drawn, like in the app. On: they are drawn in grey.

parameter.name: mapSize
parameter.label: Map Image Size
parameter.description: Target edge length of the map image in pixels (default 600).

parameter.name: mapLabels
parameter.label: Map Labels
parameter.description: What is written into each room of the map image: room name (as in the app), number or both.

channel-type.label: State
channel-type.description: Overall state of the vacuum (sweeping, idle, paused, error, returning, charging, mopping, ...).

channel-type.label: Status Code
channel-type.description: Raw status property value (siid 4 / piid 1) for diagnostics.

channel-type.label: Error Code
channel-type.description: 0 = no error. Values as in DreameVacuumErrorCode of the Tasshack reference implementation.

channel-type.label: Command
channel-type.description: Send: start, pause, stop, dock, locate. start also resumes a paused mop washing or return to the station.

channel-type.label: Suction Level
channel-type.description: Suction level: quiet, standard, strong, turbo.

channel-type.label: Volume
channel-type.description: Voice volume in percent (0 to 100).

channel-type.label: Do Not Disturb
channel-type.description: Do not disturb is active (read only).

channel-type.label: Cleaning Mode (raw)
channel-type.description: Raw packed value (siid 4 / piid 23) for diagnostics.

channel-type.label: Water Level (raw)
channel-type.description: Raw value (siid 4 / piid 5) for diagnostics.

channel-type.label: Cleaning Time
channel-type.description: Duration of the current/last cleaning.

channel-type.label: Cleaned Area
channel-type.description: Area of the current/last cleaning.

channel-type.label: Consumable Left
channel-type.description: Remaining lifetime in percent (updated every few minutes).

channel-type.label: Time Left
channel-type.description: Remaining time in hours (updated every few minutes).

channel-type.label: Setting (Switch)
channel-type.description: On/off setting of the vacuum (read and write). Stays empty if the device does not support it.

channel-type.label: Carpet Cleaning
channel-type.description: Behaviour on carpets.

options.option: Vacuum, remove mop pads (depending on model)

channel-type.label: Drying Time
channel-type.description: Duration of mop drying (hours).

channel-type.label: Charge Limit
channel-type.description: Battery level up to which the robot charges (property 28/47, 80 to 100 percent).

channel-type.label: Off-Peak Time
channel-type.description: Time in format HH:mm for off-peak charging.

channel-type.label: Rooms
channel-type.description: Rooms of the map as list "number: name" (read only).

channel-type.label: Refresh Map
channel-type.description: ON reloads the map from the cloud immediately; the switch then returns to OFF.

channel-type.label: Clean Rooms
channel-type.description: Rooms separated by comma, number or name (e.g. 1,2 or Kitchen@times=2/suction=strong/water=3). Without options: current suction and water level, once. Option room uses the room settings stored in the app.

channel-type.label: Clean Zones
channel-type.description: Zones as x1,y1,x2,y2 in map units (mm), several separated by semicolon, optionally with options, e.g. -1000,-500,2000,1500@times=2/suction=strong/water=2. Without options: current suction and water level, once.

channel-type.label: Cleaning Mode
channel-type.description: Vacuum, mop, vacuum and mop, or mop after vacuum (value in 4/23, only the lowest 2 bits are changed).

channel-type.label: Mop Water Level
channel-type.description: Water level when mopping (1 to 32, property 28/1).

channel-type.label: Station Status
channel-type.description: Status of the base station as text (read only).

channel-type.label: Station Percentage
channel-type.description: Percentage value of the base station (read only).

channel-type.label: Station Flag
channel-type.description: Yes/no status of the base station (read only).

channel-type.label: Base Station Command
channel-type.description: Command for the base station.

channel-type.label: Reset Consumable
channel-type.description: Resets the counter after replacement: main_brush, side_brush, filter, sensor, wheel, scale_inhibitor, washboard.

channel-type.label: CleanGenius
channel-type.description: AI controlled cleaning: off, routine_cleaning, deep_cleaning (only effective with mop pads attached).

channel-type.label: CleanGenius Mode
channel-type.description: CleanGenius mode: vacuum_and_mop or mop_after_vacuum.

channel-type.label: Change Room Settings
channel-type.description: Write settings per room, e.g. "Kitchen@times=2/suction=strong/water=2/mode=sweeping_and_mopping/order=1, 9@times=1". Options: times 1-3, suction quiet/standard/strong/turbo, water 1-3, mode sweeping/mopping/sweeping_and_mopping, order = position in the cleaning sequence. Only while docked.

channel-type.label: Error Text
channel-type.description: Description of the current error code (read only).

channel-type.label: Last Cleaning
channel-type.description: One line about the last cleaning: start, duration, area, result (read only).

channel-type.label: Cleaning History
channel-type.description: The last 10 cleanings, one line per run, newest first (read only).

channel-type.label: Clean Spots
channel-type.description: Points as x,y in map units (mm), several separated by semicolon, optionally with options, e.g. 700,-1500@times=2/suction=quiet/water=2. About 1.5 m² around the point are cleaned.

channel-type.label: Room Coordinates
channel-type.description: One line per room: bounding rectangle (zone x1,y1,x2,y2) and a safely reachable point near the room centre in map units (mm), read only. For use with zone and spot cleaning.

channel-type.label: Robot Position
channel-type.description: Position of the robot (x,y in mm) with room, station and timestamp of the last map (read only). During cleaning and return the map is reloaded every minute.

channel-type.label: Go To Point
channel-type.description: Target point as x,y in map units (mm). The robot drives there and stays (only on models with camera).

channel-type.label: Remote Control
channel-type.description: One step: forward, backward, left, right, stop or rotation,velocity (rotation -360..360, velocity -600..600).

channel-type.label: Shortcuts
channel-type.description: One line per shortcut: number, name and "running" if active (read only).

channel-type.label: Shortcut Command
channel-type.description: start:number or name (without prefix the shortcut is started), rename:number=new name or delete:number.

channel-type.label: Edit Rooms
channel-type.description: Room@option, several rooms separated by semicolon, options separated by slash: name=new name, visible=on|off, floor=none|wood|tile, mop=A|B|C. Example: Utility@name=Utility room/floor=tile. Not during cleaning.

channel-type.label: Map Command
channel-type.description: rename:new name (rename the current map) or backup (back up the current map in the cloud). Not during cleaning.

channel-type.label: Room Progress
channel-type.description: Finished, skipped and pending rooms of the running job (read only).

channel-type.label: Current Room
channel-type.description: Room the robot is in according to the last map (read only).

channel-type.label: Detected Obstacles
channel-type.description: One line per obstacle: number, type, position (mm), ignored if applicable (read only).

channel-type.label: Ignore Obstacle
channel-type.description: number=ignore or number=restore (number from the Detected Obstacles channel). Not during cleaning.

channel-type.label: Room Settings
channel-type.description: One line per room: mode, suction, water, repeats, order, last cleaning (read only).

channel-type.label: Map
channel-type.description: Rendered map as PNG in the light theme (app style, transparent background).

channel-type.label: Map (dark)
channel-type.description: Rendered map as PNG in the dark theme. Only rendered if an item is linked.
